prose: Why do Scorpio’s plants come armed with thorns, stings and bitter, blood-moving virtues? Herbalists Kyle Denton (Tippecanoe Herbs) and Michelle Lundquist join Mario Garza (Symbolic Studies), Slick Dissident and Chance Garton to read mugwort, wormwood, damiana, rose, rose hips, stinging nettle, lemon balm, yellow dock, ashwagandha, calendula and comfrey through astrology and the doctrine of signatures, the old art of reading a plant’s shape, color, scent and growth as clues to its healing gifts.

Scorpio, the fixed water sign of sex, death and regeneration, governs the pelvis, where the organs of generation sit beside the organs of elimination. Its season calls for fasting and letting go, and this panel follows that thread through the Death card and the five petaled Venus Rose, the gate of the great mystery at Antares, and what Kyle calls boundary medicine: the Martian thorns and stings that guard Venus’s gifts.
Remastered from Vibe Rant episode 64 (originally aired November 18, 2022), with improved audio and the tangents trimmed.
